boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten reservable and open-access study environments at Rutgers–New Brunswick libraries, each documented with current room details and amenities.

cards.title: DLC Pitch Room
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Reserve this 12-seat room when your group needs a display and two whiteboards for presenting, brainstorming, or working through a shared plan.
cards.short_summary: A large, presentation-ready collaboration room also called the Red Room.
cards.evidence_claim: The DLC Pitch Room is a 12-seat group-study space with a Samsung display, two whiteboards, power, Wi-Fi, USB charging, HDMI, and open access.
cards.source_title: DLC Pitch Room | Rutgers University Libraries
cards.access_notes: First floor, Digital Learning Commons area. Open access; reservations are limited to one Alexander study room per NetID per day, up to three hours.

cards.title: DLC Study Room
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, DLC Room 131 · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Book this six-seat room for a working session that benefits from a large display, whiteboard, charging hubs, and a single group table.
cards.short_summary: A six-seat Digital Learning Commons room built around shared-screen work.
cards.evidence_claim: DLC Study Room 131 is a six-seat group-study space with a Samsung display, whiteboard, power, Wi-Fi, USB charging hubs, HDMI, and open access.
cards.source_title: DLC Study Room | Rutgers University Libraries
cards.access_notes: First floor in the Digital Learning Commons. Open access; current Rutgers students, faculty, staff, and affiliates with a valid NetID may reserve it.

cards.title: Study Room 301A
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use this four-seat room for a compact group session; it is across from the elevators on the Huntington Street side and has power and Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat group room positioned by the third-floor North Wing elevators.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 301A is a four-seat group-study room on Alexander Library's third-floor North Wing, with power, Wi-Fi, open access, and a group table and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing, across from elevators on the Huntington Street side. Open access; one Alexander study-room booking per NetID per day, maximum three hours.

cards.title: Study Room 301B
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Reserve this four-seat room for a small collaboration and use the table, chairs, power, and Wi-Fi with your own device.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat third-floor North Wing group-study room.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 301B is a four-seat group-study space in Alexander Library's third-floor North Wing with power, Wi-Fi, open access, and a group table and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing. Open access; current Rutgers students, faculty, staff, and affiliates with a valid NetID may reserve it for up to three hours.

cards.title: Study Room 301C
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Set up a four-person working block here with your own device; the room provides a group table, chairs, power, and Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A small third-floor group room with the core setup for shared work.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 301C is a four-seat group-study space in Alexander Library's third-floor North Wing with power, Wi-Fi, open access, and a group table and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing. Open access; current Rutgers students, faculty, staff, and affiliates with a valid NetID may reserve it for up to three hours.

cards.title: Study Room 301D
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Plan a four-person session in this George Street-side room, bringing your own device and using the room's table, power, and Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat group-study room on the George Street side of Alexander.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 301D is a four-seat group-study space on the third floor of Alexander Library's North Wing, with power, Wi-Fi, open access, and a group table and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing, on the George Street side. Open access; one Alexander study-room booking per NetID per day, maximum three hours.

cards.title: Study Room 301E
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use the dry-erase board and request markers, a surge protector, or laptop speakers from the desk when preparing a small group project.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat group room with a dry-erase board and loanable accessories.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 301E is a four-seat group-study space on Alexander Library's third-floor North Wing; it has a dry-erase board and offers markers, a surge protector, and laptop speakers for checkout.
cards.source_title: Alexander Library - Room 301E | Rutgers Study Space Finder
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing, across from the elevators. The Study Space Finder lists the room as available to book; confirm the reservation slot before going.

cards.title: Study Room 301F
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Bring your own device to this four-seat room on the Senior Street/Parking Deck side, then use its group table, chairs, power, and Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat group room on Alexander's Senior Street/Parking Deck side.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 301F is a four-seat group-study room on the third floor of Alexander Library's North Wing, with power, Wi-Fi, open access, and a group table and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing, on the Senior Street/Parking Deck side. Open access; one Alexander study-room booking per NetID per day, maximum three hours.

cards.title: Study Room 310
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Reserve this two-seat room for solo work or a one-on-one session, and bring your own device to use alongside its individual desks and Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A two-seat room intended for solo study or work with one other person.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 310 is a two-seat individual-study space on Alexander Library's third-floor North Wing, designed for solo study or collaboration with one other person and equipped with power and Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing, on the Huntington Street side. Open access; one Alexander study-room booking per NetID per day, maximum three hours.

cards.title: Study Room 319
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, North Wing · College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Choose this two-seat room for independent work or a focused pair session; it sits on the George Street side and includes individual desks, power, and Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A two-seat individual-study room on Alexander's George Street side.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 319 is a two-seat individual-study space in Alexander Library's third-floor North Wing, designed for solo study or collaboration with one other person and equipped with individual desks, power, and Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Third floor, North Wing, on the George Street side. Open access; one Alexander study-room booking per NetID per day, maximum three hours.
